difference_from_nearest: QDRA allocates a declared resolution budget by decision-boundary value; ATSCWC changes the sequential measurement policy itself and thereby the stochastic stream seen by an online calibration-width controller.
external_prior_art: Yang & Zhang (2026), Conformalized Rate-Adaptive Sensing, jointly adapts sensing/acquisition rate and conformal calibration/coverage.
mechanism_removing_comparator: same CWC and same query budget with ActiveThresholdSensing selection replaced by a frozen evenly-spaced query schedule
new_failure_mode: A calibration controller receives a needlessly noisy/wide posterior stream when measurement locations are frozen even though the same measurement budget can be targeted adaptively.
non_additive_interaction: Active sensing changes the data-generating measurement locations that create the center/scale stream subsequently controlled for coverage; the acquisition policy and calibration state form a closed loop.
